facts.fact: StackAdapt's Creative Tactics feature lets advertisers set campaign parameters so certain creatives run under defined circumstances, without creating a separate campaign for each rule.
facts.quote: Creative Tactics allows you to set parameters on a campaign to use certain creatives under defined circumstances, without having to create a separate campaign for each rule.

facts.fact: According to StackAdapt, Creative Tactics can vary creatives by time of day, day of the week, device type, supply source, and domain, among other parameters.
facts.quote: you could choose to show different creatives based on the time of day, day of the week, device type, supply source, and even by domain

facts.fact: StackAdapt's Geo creative tactic is described as useful for brands with multiple locations, letting them show different creatives to audiences based on location.
facts.quote: For brands that have multiple locations, opting for the Geo creative tactic can be incredibly useful to be relevant to your audience.

facts.fact: In StackAdapt's example, a healthcare brand ran different native ads for each of its locations within the same campaign using Creative Tactics.
facts.quote: With Creative Tactics, you can run both ads in the same campaign.

facts.fact: StackAdapt suggests a recipe brand can show breakfast recipe creatives in the morning and dinner recipe creatives in the evening using the time-of-day tactic.
facts.quote: could showcase breakfast recipes in the morning and dinner recipes in the evening.

facts.fact: StackAdapt's Domain Category creative tactic can show a retail bank's student account ad on educational domains and its mortgage ad on real estate domains.
